description: Sou estudante de Engenharia Elétrica na Univates, com interesse em eletrônica, automação, programação e exploração espacial. Estou desenvolvendo o Mission Control, um jogo de gerenciamento de missões espaciais. Busco pessoas com conhecimentos em Godot, programação, pixel art, design 2D ou pesquisa científica para colaborar no projeto. Criatividade e vontade de aprender são bem-vindas!
summary: Mission Control is a space mission simulation game designed for children aged 7 to 12. The objective is to ensure the operation and survival of a lunar base through missions, exploration, and resource management, requiring logical thinking to overcome the challenges encountered. Given the younger target audience, the game features a user-friendly interface and guidance systems that assist players in completing missions—even when faced with difficult circumstances, such as a shortage of resources. The game aims to present space exploration and its associated challenges in an interactive and accessible way, introducing young players to scientific and technological concepts while sparking an interest in space sciences.
details:
Mission Control is a 2D lunar exploration game for children aged 7 to 12. Players take on the role of a young astronaut responsible for establishing and maintaining a lunar base while exploring the surrounding area. During missions, players install equipment such as the Roll-Out Solar Array (ROSA), connect power cables, and monitor resources including energy, oxygen, food, and shield levels. They must also perform maintenance tasks, such as removing accumulated regolith from solar panels. Reconnaissance drones are controlled using Cartesian coordinates to investigate points of interest, contributing to research progression and the development of the story.

The game introduces basic concepts of space exploration through practical tasks and interactive challenges. An onboard virtual assistant named LUNA guides players through predefined dialogues and contextual alerts. The interface and controls are designed to make the game accessible to younger audiences while encouraging logical reasoning and resource management.

The project was developed using Godot Engine 4.7.2 and GDScript, with the Dialogue Manager addon for dialogue systems and LibreSprite for pixel art. Actually only supports Windows. Scientific concepts incorporated into the gameplay include lunar gravity (1.65 m/s²), regolith accumulation, and energy management. The main goal is to introduce children to the challenges of living and working on the Moon while encouraging their interest in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM)
